edit.statement: 'Is measured in' is inverse functional: each SI unit measures at most one distinct quantity.
edit.subject: measured_in
edit.original: Several quantities can share an SI unit: energy, work and heat are all measured in joules.
edit.scope: Which SI unit a physical quantity is measured in; the units themselves are not edited.

direct.prompt: Can two explicitly different quantities be measured in the same SI unit?

paraphrase.prompt: Does 'is measured in' permit one SI unit to serve two different quantities?

cross_lingual.prompt: 两个明确不同的物理量可以用同一个国际单位来度量吗？
¿Pueden dos magnitudes explícitamente distintas medirse en la misma unidad del SI?

derived.prompt: Proposed facts: energy is measured in joules; work is measured in joules; energy and work are explicitly different quantities. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent with the rule?
bridge: energy and work are explicitly different quantities.

derived.prompt: Proposed facts: electric potential difference is measured in volts; electromotive force is measured in volts; potential difference and electromotive force are explicitly different quantities. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent with the rule?
bridge: electric potential difference is measured in volts.
electromotive force is measured in volts.
potential difference and electromotive force are explicitly different quantities.

derived.prompt: Facts: heat is measured in joules; work is measured in joules; no statement says whether heat and work are different quantities. From these facts and the rule alone, is 'heat and work are the same quantity' entailed, ruled out, or undetermined?
bridge: no statement says whether heat and work are different quantities.

derived.prompt: Facts: the quantity Flux-Q is measured in zorbs; the quantity Drift-R is measured in zorbs; no statement says whether they are different quantities. From these facts and the rule alone, is 'Flux-Q and Drift-R are the same quantity' entailed, ruled out, or undetermined?
bridge: the quantity Flux-Q is measured in zorbs.
the quantity Drift-R is measured in zorbs.
no statement says whether they are different quantities.

unrelated_near.prompt: Proposed facts: the Moon orbits the Earth; the International Space Station orbits the Earth; the Moon and the International Space Station are explicitly different. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent?
Proposed facts: the electron has a charge of -1 e; the muon has a charge of -1 e; the electron and the muon are explicitly different particles. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent?

unrelated_far.prompt: Proposed facts: Tom lives in Paris; Ana lives in Paris; Tom and Ana are explicitly different people. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent?
Proposed facts: book A is written in French; book B is written in French; the two books are explicitly different. Is this configuration consistent or inconsistent?

notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
